# Devolity

> > Devolity delivers secure cloud solutions, DevOps engineering, and comprehensive cybersecurity services for enterprise digital transformation.

Devolity is a full-stack technology services provider specializing in cloud infrastructure, security compliance, and software development automation. The company serves enterprises across managed hosting, cloud migration, DevOps, and regulatory compliance (PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001).

## Key Topics

- DevOps & CI/CD
- Cloud Migration
- PCI DSS Compliance
- Kubernetes
- Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
- HIPAA Compliance
- Disaster Recovery
- Application Security
- Network Security
- AWS & Azure
- Managed Hosting
- Data Protection
- Business Continuity
- Endpoint Detection & Response
- Security Compliance Management

## Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering

- [Complete Managed Cloud Solutions for Companies](https://devolity.com/engineering/managed-cloud): Managed cloud services with VPC, migration, monitoring, optimization support
- [Migrate your business to cloud securely](https://devolity.com/solutions/cloud-migration): Cloud migration services with VPC, security, and hybrid cloud support
- [Simplify DevOps Engineering](https://devolity.com/engineering/devops): DevOps engineering: CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud integration, automation
- [Excellent cost-to-benefit productive business](https://devolity.com/engineering/public-cloud): Public cloud services with DevOps, CI/CD, auto-scaling, enterprise solutions
- [Lets Your Company customized, Security](https://devolity.com/engineering/private-cloud): Private cloud solutions with security, data privacy, compliance, single-tenant
- [Managed Hosting, Dedicated and Cloud Solutions](https://devolity.com/solutions/managed-hosting): Managed hosting with Plesk, cPanel, WordPress support and cloud solutions

## Security & Compliance

- [Leading Provider of PCI DSS Compliance Solutions and Certificates](https://devolity.com/solutions/pci-dss): PCI DSS compliance for Visa, MasterCard, payment card security certification
- [ISO Compliance Certificate by Devolity - Simplifying Compliance!](https://devolity.com/solutions/iso): ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS compliance certificates and management solutions
- [Protecting the Integrity, Availability, and Confidentiality of Data](https://devolity.com/solutions/information-security-management): Information security with GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS compliance and data protection
- [Security Compliance Management for Ultimate Protection](https://devolity.com/solutions/security-compliance-management): Security compliance with PCI DSS, HIPAA, compliance assessment solutions
- [Protecting Software from Attacks](https://devolity.com/solutions/application-security): Application security: WAF, static/dynamic testing, API protection, threat detection
- [Increasing Infra. Security and Reducing Cyber Threats](https://devolity.com/solutions/network-security): Network security with DDoS protection, threat detection, ransomware defense

## Data Protection & Business Continuity
